name: Terminus Combat VFX Kit
status: Integrated presentation assets; rendered 3D and listening review pending on a WebGL-capable device.

assets.name: Crescent sweep
assets.description: Tapered blade arc. Orient the broad edge toward travel; scale with the actual weapon sweep.

assets.name: Weapon trail strip
assets.description: Tintable ribbon mask. Horizontal U follows history-to-current weapon sample; V spans the blade.

assets.name: Contact star
assets.description: Single impact flash. Use only at the contact frame; fast opacity falloff.

assets.name: Broken impact ring
assets.description: Expand on the ground at weapon contact; four detached segments preserve open space.

assets.name: Directional sparks
assets.description: Separate impact debris. Prefer individual emitter sprites or a short burst sheet.

assets.name: Contact glint
assets.description: Compact four-point white core for a crisp readable weapon contact.

assets.name: Fire / Containment Orbit
assets.description: Segmented containment orbit with four open cardinal gates and four suspended orbit beads. Rotate slowly during gathering, tighten at release. Center pivot 256,256; tintable white mask.

assets.name: Fire / Condensed Nucleus
assets.description: Three interleaved particle orbits enclose a faceted hot nucleus. Pulse the nucleus and counter-rotate this layer against the containment orbit; shrink before release.

assets.name: Fire / Rising Ember
assets.description: A tapered, fractured flame shard for small drifting or orbiting particles. Its pointed tip faces local -Y. Use varied scales and rotations; preserve the open core.

assets.name: Fire / Release Lance
assets.description: A directional release flash pointing local +X. The long hot spine and curved split vanes stretch forward as the contained nucleus releases. Pivot 256,256.

assets.name: Fire / Atomic Eruption
assets.description: An upright eruption silhouette with separate peripheral shards and three upward tongues. Place around the target as crossed planes; rise and dissolve on impact. Purely visual; it does not establish a burn status.

assets.name: Fire / Heat Shock Ring
assets.description: A flattened impact ring with an interrupted outer wave and four detached heat streaks. Expand horizontally at impact and fade quickly. Authoring already includes perspective flattening; use a camera-facing ground-height plane or adjust aspect in integration.

assets.name: Shimmer / Traveling Wave Front
assets.description: Three open expanding wave crests. Keep the outer leading edge brightest; expand across the ground with independent opacity envelopes. Canvas pivot is (256,256).

assets.name: Shimmer / Concentric Light Ripple
assets.description: Nested elliptical light ripples. Scale as a single recipient halo or separate each native ellipse for staggered pulses. Canvas pivot is (256,256).

assets.name: Shimmer / Woven Connecting Thread
assets.description: Two flowing light threads with a soft crossing and brighter endpoint beads. Map along a caster-to-recipient ribbon; animate texture travel toward the recipient. Canvas pivot is (256,256).

assets.name: Shimmer / Recipient Glint
assets.description: A four-point luminous glint shaped as a single curved diamond, with quiet diagonal echoes. Pulse only for actual heal recipients. Canvas pivot is (256,256).

assets.name: Shimmer / Interlaced Light Lenses
assets.description: Three interlaced light lenses surrounding a quiet core. An original casting motif with no assigned meaning in the established sigil language; rotate the lenses independently. Canvas pivot is (256,256).

assets.name: Shimmer / Swept Light Ribbon
assets.description: A broad tapered light ribbon with two separately editable trailing strands. Sweep from Ariadne’s hand or map onto a curved traveling surface. Canvas pivot is (256,256).

assets.name: Ice / Prismatic Crystal
assets.description: Upright faceted crystal silhouette for a rising ice shard. Its opaque edge and translucent facet separate shape from interior light. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Ice / Crystal Shatter
assets.description: Eight asymmetric fragments leave a clear central silhouette. Separate the vector pieces for radial debris; this is one contact burst. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Ice / Frost Boundary
assets.description: Circular top-down, unprojected frost boundary. Lay on a ground plane and expand briefly; rotate sparse crystalline points independently. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Ice / Lattice Cast
assets.description: Circular top-down construction with a hexagonal containment lattice. Rotate as a hand-facing cast motif; inner and outer layers remain independent. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Lightning / Main Bolt
assets.description: Vertical striking bolt. Stretch from the overhead origin to target contact; briefly invert its orientation for secondary flicker. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Lightning / Forked Arc
assets.description: Branching angular discharge mask for connecting two points. Main current travels from upper center toward the lower tip; use short-lived flicker. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Lightning / Charge Ring
assets.description: Circular top-down charge ring with four angular current gates. Rotate or pulse the independent arcs; suitable for hand, shield or ground orientation. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Lightning / Ion Spark
assets.description: Compact angular ion spark with broken diagonal branches. Use a very short contact pulse and small emitter copies. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Resonance / Closure Seal
assets.description: Circular top-down seal with three closing teeth and a triangular nucleus. Assemble on a completed skillchain, then hold only for the actual burst window. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Resonance / Four Seal Segments
assets.description: Four separated circular top-down arc sections with inward teeth. Animate each vector segment inward to communicate chain closure. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Resonance / Concentric Pulse
assets.description: Three circular top-down rings for a resonant shock pulse. Expand outer rings with decreasing opacity; the artwork has no baked perspective. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Resonance / Burst Crown
assets.description: Six directional resonant blades around a faceted nucleus. Use as the brief completed-burst flash; maintain negative space between blades. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Aegis / Faceted Ward
assets.description: Upright shield emblem with a bright defensive edge and translucent inner field. Face toward the viewer or incoming hit; the silhouette is not a ground ring. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Aegis / Ward Fragments
assets.description: Six detached ward plates arranged around an empty center. Trigger only on shield consumption; move each piece outward and fade once. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Aegis / Protective Arch
assets.description: Upright protective hemisphere illustration, already viewed from the side. Use as a billboard or rebuild in geometry; do not project this arch as a ground circle. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Aegis / Defensive Glint
assets.description: A compact defensive contact glint with two orbit fragments. Flash at the protected actor when the one-hit ward blocks an incoming attack. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Martial / Elemental Arrow
assets.description: Horizontal arrow pointing +X. Stretch its shaft along source-to-target travel; element tint comes from the actual shot event. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Martial / Piercing Lance
assets.description: A narrow +X thrust mask with three receding streaks. Align along the weapon axis and collapse quickly after contact. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Martial / Shout Pressure
assets.description: Side-facing expanding sound arcs toward +X. Orient away from Heracles; use a short outward pressure wave for Provoke. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Martial / Dash Echo
assets.description: Three tapered +X dash streaks at staggered heights. Attach to authoritative movement; never use this texture to move the actor. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Enhancement / Revelry Pulse
assets.description: Circular top-down rhythmic party-buff motif with eight bright pulses and a flowing celebratory center. Pulse once on application; persistent stacks remain state-owned. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Enhancement / Rapid Weave
assets.description: Three interlaced particle paths with a central aperture. Rotate bounded layers around Hecate while actual Rapid Weave charges remain; circular overall footprint. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Enhancement / Guard Stance
assets.description: Nested upright defensive chevrons and a braced base. Pulse on Guard activation; use actual guard duration for any persistent overlay. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.

assets.name: Enhancement / Mending Tether
assets.description: Horizontal curved tether with a compact light knot at its center. Bend or stretch between actual caster and recipient; pulse on confirmed healing ticks. Center pivot [0.5,0.5]; transparent white tintable mask.
